# SkillGate

> Trust infrastructure for AI
 agent skills.

## What is this?

SkillGate s
cans AI agent skills for security issues, cal
culates a Trust Score, and generates a report
. It's like Snyk for AI skills — but open s
ource, local-first, and free.

## When to use
 this

Use SkillGate when:
- You want to audi
t or review an AI agent skill for security is
sues
- You ask "is this skill safe?" or "can 
I trust this skill?"
- You are about to insta
ll a third-party skill and want to check it f
irst
- You want to compare two skills and see
 which one is more trustworthy

## Quick star
t

```bash
# Scan a skill folder
python scrip
ts/skillgate.py scan ./path/to/skill/

# Get 
JSON output
python scripts/skillgate.py scan 
./path/to/skill/ --format json

# Get HTML re
port
python scripts/skillgate.py scan ./path/
to/skill/ --format html
```

## What it check
s

- Secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords)
- 
Dangerous code (eval, exec, os.system)
- Vuln
erable dependencies
- SKILL.md quality (missi
ng description, version, license)
- Suspiciou
s network calls
- Unnecessary file system acc
ess

## Trust Score

Start at 100, subtract b
y severity:
- CRITICAL: -15
- HIGH: -8
- MEDI
UM: -3
- LOW: -1

Grades: A+ (90+), A (80+), 
B (70+), C (60+), D (<60)

## Known limits

-
 Static scanner only — doesn't run the skil
l
- Catches known patterns, not zero-days
- C
lean scan = "no obvious red flags", not "100%
 safe"
